# Ping100

> Browser-based IP reputation, platform-specific IP screening, browser fingerprint, DNS and WebRTC diagnostics.

## How to interpret results

IP and platform scores run from 0 to 100; higher is better. Platform scores are Ping100 heuristics, not provider-issued scores or measured ban probabilities. Public pages describe the tools; visitor-specific results require JavaScript and are not published or available as a public score database. Missing signals affect estimates. Supported-country policy and scoring assumptions are documented separately in each platform methodology, with sources.

## Languages and discovery

Supported language query values: en, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ja, ko, fr, es, pt, de, ar. Use ?lang= to request a stable language.
